Based on those two listings, there's no reason to pick one over the other — they are identical.

Both are selling the same product:

| Rating shown | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| Returns | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. |
| Warranty | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| Specs / In the box | over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency, up to 40 hrs with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable | Same |

The 4.3 star rating is for the product and is the same on both pages, so it doesn't tell us anything about the sellers themselves.

If price, shipping speed, returns, and warranty are all the same, buy from either. If you have a tie-breaker outside of these pages — like you've used one store before, have loyalty points, prefer a payment method one offers, or find better independent reviews of the seller — use that.
